fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire plant perimeter is enclosed by chain-link fencing (confirmed in multiple Street View captures from the east access road). A single internal access road runs along the east side from the public road network in the N; the truck entrance is a controlled gate where a driveway crosses the fence line onto this access road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A guard booth is likely at this flagship 'near net zero' secured plant, but could not be visually confirmed - z21 satellite at the gate zone is washed out and Street View of the entrance is heavily sun-glared. Marked true at medium confidence and flagged.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large internal paved aprons and trailer yard between the gate and the dock areas - ample inside holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long east-side access road plus expansive internal paved yard - holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide access road and large paved internal aprons with significant unused width - room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single access road / entrance serves both in and out.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound - low confidence, imagery washed out.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors along the building with trailers backed in; partial visibility - estimated 25-50 band, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard on the NE with dozens of trailers in rows, plus additional trailers on the W side - exceeds 50 stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Could not clearly confirm physically separate ship/receive dock clusters - left false, flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Set in the Sonoran desert at the edge of Casa Grande, surrounded by farmland and open desert - Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large connected plant building mass with attached process structures - not a multi-cluster campus. An electrical substation NE of the property is a separate utility.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identifiable - low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - a rail line runs along the east edge of the property and rail cars/tankers are parked on a spur serving the plant (visible in Street View and satellite).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box yields ~95 acres; public sources cite the building at ~188,000 sq ft on 200+ acres of owned land (much of it desert buffer).
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~110 trailers counted across the NE drop yard, W side, and dock faces - approximate.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Overhead estimate; imagery resolution and trailer obstruction limit confidence.
